metadata.title: Prevent HTTP connection exhaustion and expose pool metrics
metadata.author: shoummu1

description:
## :rocket: Performance Improvement PR

## :pushpin: Summary
- Prevents creating new per-request `httpx.AsyncClient` instances which can exhaust system sockets under load.
- Uses the existing `SharedHttpClient` (no new factory added); replaces per-request `httpx.AsyncClient` usages in `translate.py`; stores configured `httpx.Limits` and exposes pool-limit metrics to Prometheus.
- Fixes unreliable pool-inspection code and Prometheus registration issues that caused test/runtime failures.

## :link: Related Issue
Closes: #1676

## :chart_with_upwards_trend: Root Cause
- Callers created a new `httpx.AsyncClient(...)` per request which can open many sockets and exhaust resources under concurrency.
- Code attempted to inspect httpx internal transport/pool objects (e.g., using `len()`), which is fragile and incompatible across httpx versions.
- Prometheus metric registration used `Gauge.set_function()` in a way that caused registry errors during tests.
- `AsyncClient` limits were not recorded centrally, making it impossible to reliably expose pool-limit metrics.

## ✅ What Was Already in the Codebase
1. `SharedHttpClient` service (`mcpgateway/services/http_client_service.py`)
   - Singleton intended to provide a single shared HTTP client for the app
   - Configured to manage connections (defaults via settings)
   - Reuses connections instead of creating new ones

2. Configuration (`mcpgateway/config.py` and `.env.example`)
   - `HTTPX_MAX_CONNECTIONS=200`
   - `HTTPX_MAX_KEEPALIVE_CONNECTIONS=100`
   - `HTTPX_KEEPALIVE_EXPIRY=30.0`

3. Lifespan Management (`mcpgateway/main.py`)
   - Startup: initializes shared client
   - Shutdown: closes shared client cleanly

4. Most consumers already used the shared client:
   - `llm_admin_router.py` ✅
   - `llm_provider_service.py` ✅
   - `sso_service.py` ✅
   - `tool_service.py` ✅
   - `keycloak_discovery.py` ✅
   - `catalog_service.py` ✅
   - `a2a_service.py` ✅
   - `gateway_service.py` ✅

## :wrench: Files Modified
- Files modified:
  - `mcpgateway/services/http_client_service.py` — central shared client enhancements, store `httpx.Limits`, provide `get_pool_stats()` and lifecycle cleanup
  - `mcpgateway/services/metrics.py` — added Prometheus gauges for pool limits and replaced fragile `set_function()` usage with an explicit `update_http_pool_metrics()` call
  - `mcpgateway/main.py` — ensure metrics update runs after shared client init
  - `mcpgateway/translate.py` — replaced per-request `AsyncClient(...)` usage with `get_isolated_http_client()` (only file requiring this change)
  - `mcpgateway/cli_export_import.py` — replaced per-request client creation with isolated client helper where applicable

- Key behavior changes:
  - Use a shared, lazily-initialized `AsyncClient` (`SharedHttpClient`) for the app
  - Use the existing `get_isolated_http_client()` contextmanager for short-lived isolated clients when needed
  - Store configured `httpx.Limits` on the shared client and expose metrics from those stored values
  - Avoid inspecting internal transport pool objects
  - Update Prometheus metrics after shared-client initialization to avoid test-time registry errors
  - Expose two new Prometheus gauges:
    - `http_pool_max_connections` — configured max connections
    - `http_pool_max_keepalive_connections` — configured max keepalive connections
  - Metrics are updated at startup after the shared client is initialized to ensure values are present in `/metrics/prometheus`

## :test_tube: Verification
| Test | Command | Status |
|------|---------|--------|
| Translate unit tests | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_translate.py -v` | ✅ 83 passed |
| Metrics tests (post-fix) | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_metrics.py -v` | ✅ 4 passed |
| CLI/coverage boost tests | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_simple_coverage_boost.py -v` | ✅ 7 passed |
| Consumer tests (patching `get_http_client`) | targeted `pytest` run | ✅ 73 passed, 1 failed (unrelated) |
